g.text: ichor-ui issues an ID token (5 minutes) and refresh token 1.
The page refreshes, a minute before the ID token ends
Refresh token 1 is retired. A new ID token and refresh
token 2 come back. Each refresh retires the last token.
The session lifetime ends (12 hours by default)
It does not slide, even in a tab you are using. The next
refresh is refused and you sign in again.
ichor-ui refuses every earlier ID token within 10 s
and the next refresh is refused. kubectl keeps the
ID token it holds until its 5 minutes end.
The refresh token is revoked at the issuer, if it
can be reached. An ID token already issued runs out
The whole chain ends, as a stolen copy would. The
The Secret that holds the chain rewinds, so a token
refreshed after the snapshot counts as retired and
ends the chain. Users, passwords and roles rewind
